research_result.description: Waterfall.io provides a B2B data solution and API for contact prospecting, contact and company enrichment, phone lookup, email verification, and job change tracking.
research_result.credential_requirements: API access requires an API key provided as part of a custom contract after booking a sales call with the Waterfall team.

evidence.claim: Waterfall API authenticates requests using an API key passed in the x-api-key header.
Obtaining an API key requires a contract with Waterfall.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: To access the API, you need the API key provided in your contract.

evidence.claim: Accessing Waterfall involves booking a call with the team to discuss custom business needs.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Every company has different needs. Talk to our team (most likely one of the founders) to share your use case and see how Waterfall can help.

evidence.claim: Waterfall provides a REST API covering endpoints for prospector, contact/company enrichment, phone enrichment, job changes, email verification, and account reporting.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Complete API reference for Waterfall — find and enrich contacts, prospect by title and company, verify emails, and more.
